Fixed in `289b3b71c8352738395bf290bc1ae10dc405ee15`.

`ClientToolSurfaceAttestationSchema` now carries a `superRefine` that enforces both the chronological ordering and a maximum lifetime:

- `expiresAt` must be strictly after `observedAt` (equal or inverted intervals are rejected);
- `expiresAt - observedAt` must not exceed the canonical five-minute bound.

The check reads only the timestamps already validated by the existing boundary, so no new time authority is introduced and no field or bound is relaxed. An `expiresAt` years after `observedAt` can therefore no longer make client callability look current indefinitely.

Covered by two regression tests added in `b2955874590b9655aa7a77a94fe5a6a51ec249f9` (`tests/clientToolSurfaceAttestation.test.ts`), verified RED before the fix and GREEN after, with MCP CI `validate` SUCCESS on the exact head.
